title: Ceramics Courses - Fall 2026/Spring 2027
source_quote: The ceramic studio incorporates 18 wheels, 5 electric and 4 gas reduction kilns, 1 raku and saggar, and a soda kiln with a dedicated teaching team.
evidence_sentence: The ceramics program description lists a soda kiln as part of the studio's equipped facilities.
evidence_quote: and a soda kiln with a dedicated teaching team
summary: Mendocino College ceramics courses use the studio's equipped kilns including a soda kiln. Students enrolled in ceramics classes participate in firings as part of their coursework.
how_to_join: Register for ceramics courses through Mendocino College class schedule registration.
